train_jsp_model: train a job shop scheduling model using reinforcement learning on a dataset with configurable epochs and batch size
evaluate_jsp_model: evaluate a trained job shop scheduling model on a test dataset and print loss and reward metrics
create_model_jsp: create a jspModel instance with configurable embedding size and optionally load pretrained weights or resume training
run_jsp_training_cli: run the job shop scheduling training script via argparse CLI with options for dataset paths, epochs, and batch size
run_jsp_evaluation_cli: run the job shop scheduling evaluation script via argparse CLI with the --eval flag and a test dataset path
